snippet.title: Project Corner - Official Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
🔥 Project Corner Prop Hunt: Ultimate Hide and Seek Multiplayer Gameplay!

Can you survive the ultimate game of tactical hide and seek? Welcome to Project Corner, a thrilling multiplayer Prop Hunt game where the environment is your best disguise, and every corner holds a secret! In this video, we dive deep into the chaotic, intense, and hilarious gameplay of our official Prop Hunt mode.

Wishlist Project Corner on Steam now to join the upcoming playtests and beta runs!
🔗 Wishlist on Steam! Link to the Steam Page on profile.

Whether you love outsmarting opponents as a master of disguise or hunting down targets with tactical precision, Project Corner delivers the perfect blend of competitive strategy and community fun.

🎮 ABOUT THE PROP HUNT MODE:
In Project Corner, players are split into two teams with completely opposite goals:

👥 THE HUNTERS: Your mission is to clear the location of fake objects. Start the round frozen while targets scramble, then unleash your unique hunter abilities, radars, and motion sensors. Spot the anomalies—like a shadow falling the wrong way or a misplaced crate—and strike! Hunters feature 3 unique abilities (2 regulars and 1 ultimate that unlocks after eliminating half the prop team).

📦 THE PROPS: You are the masters of disguise. Turn into a cup on a table, a wardrobe, or a cardboard box. Use the "taunt/whistle" mechanic to mock seekers for extra points, or make a sudden dash when their backs are turned. Beware: halfway through the round, the Random Prop Shuffling mechanic will swap your object out for a completely new one!

🗺️ THE MAPS: Explore unique interactive arenas changing with every single season. Sneak through The Office Building across the 30th floor and rooftop, utilizing two staircases for vertical chases with nearly 100 unique objects to transform into.

Gather your friends, create a lobby, and prove who is the ultimate detective. The clock is ticking... Ready or not, here we come!

#ProjectCorner #PropHunt #HideAndSeek #IndieDev #MultiplayerGames #Gaming #PCGaming #SteamGames #TacticalShooter #GameTrailer
